title: Spikers' Turf: FEU nabs second straight win by demolishing 3B
summary: Far Eastern University-DN Steel demolished 3B, 25-15, 25-16, 25-17, to bolster its playoffs bid in the 2026 Spikers’ Turf Invitational Conference on Wednesday at the Filoil Centre.
